properties.answer: Build it, local files only — adopt object_store with the local filesystem backend and no cloud features. Smallest useful slice; cloud backends stay one config change away with no rework. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “The graph holds pointers; a content store holds the bytes — narrative, transcripts, diagrams and drawings travel WITH the design”
properties.question: You want conversations, transcripts and hand-drawn diagrams kept as part of the design itself, with the design file just pointing at them. Nothing is being built for that yet — do you want it built now, and should those files live inside the project's repository or somewhere alongside it?
